patch_description: Add an adaptive output-direction hysteresis stage after the alpha-beta estimate. The tracker continues to update its internal level and slope on every sample, preserving responsiveness to genuine transitions, but suppresses a single small output movement that opposes the established direction. A direction reversal is accepted immediately when its magnitude exceeds the local volatility-scaled threshold, or after two consecutive opposing estimates confirm it. This specifically targets noise-induced slope changes and false reversals while imposing at most a one-sample confirmation delay for weak genuine turning points.
